'''The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game''' is an introductory Star Wars CCG product, published in March 1997. It contains eight premium cards (7 exclusive white-border plus a [[Leia (ESB Two-Player)|white-border Jedi Pack Leia]]) and two 60-card preconstructed decks. It also holds a rules booklet, a sample-game booklet (not in early boxes), and one Premiere booster. MSRP $19.95. The white-border Hoth, A New Hope and Premiere cards in the decks print a © 1996 date, unlike the other white-border and Revised printings. The exception is the Light Side [[Restraining Bolt (Unlimited)|Restraining Bolt]], printed with a © 1995 date and identical to the Premiere Unlimited card. Takara published a Japanese version.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="encyc-30">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 30: "The white-border Hoth, A New Hope, and Premiere cards included in this set included a © 1996 making them unique from other white-border or revised versions. The Light Side Restraining Bolt is an exception … It was printed with a © 1995 date, making it indistinguishable from the Unlimited offering of Premiere." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The two decks hold 120 cards in 61 different titles: the seven exclusive premiums, the white-border Leia and 53 reprints.<ref name="decipher-2p">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/esbtwoplayer/esb2playercardlist.pdf Two-Player Deck Card Lists], [[Decipher]] (1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990908013557/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/esbtwoplayer/esb2playercardlist.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="hoc-esb">[https://nslists.com/swccgesb.htm Star Wars ESB 2-Player Edition], House of Checklists (Jeff Allender). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20181112172013/http://www.nslists.com:80/swccgesb.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="esb-2p-rules">[https://wiki.swccg.com/images/c/c0/Decipher_ESB_Two_Player_Rules.pdf The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game rules booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1997), p. 16 (Two-Player Deck Card Lists). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193624/https://wiki.swccg.com/images/c/c0/Decipher_ESB_Two_Player_Rules.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The randomized Premiere booster is a reprint and is not listed here.

== Variants ==
* The 52 Hoth, A New Hope and Premiere reprints with a © 1996 date are versions found only in this product; each has its own article, titled with ''(ESB Two-Player)'', for example [[Snowtrooper (ESB Two-Player)]].<ref name="encyc-30" />
* The Light Side [[Restraining Bolt (Unlimited)|Restraining Bolt]] has a © 1995 date and is the Premiere Unlimited card.<ref name="encyc-30" />
* [[Leia (ESB Two-Player)|Leia]] is the [[Leia (Jedi Pack)|Jedi Pack]] card in white border; this box is the only source of that version.<ref name="encyc-30" />
